a.xlink:title: Central identity — customers, vendors, employees, prospects. Model: apps/contacts/models/contact.py

Contacts with vendor role. Model: apps/contacts/models/contact.py
Purchase orders to vendors. Model: apps/transactions/models/purchase.py
Shared line data — specs, related records, data at time of action. Model: apps/core/models/linkage.py

Invoice line — quantity.placed, actioned, remaining, canceled, parent. Model: apps/transactions/models/line.py

Product with quantity JSON tracking all inventory buckets. Model: apps/products/models/item.py:196 Functions: Item.quantity @ apps/products/models/item.py:238 (JSONField with on_hand, allocated, available, on_p, on_so, on_in, on_po, on_wo, on_r)

Central hub for inventory quantity deltas. All quantity changes flow through Pending before updating Item. Model: apps/core/models/pending.py:6 Functions: Pending.objects.create @ apps/transactions/services/order_to_invoice.py:332 (invoice creation) Pending.objects.create @ apps/transactions/services/proposal_to_order.py:171 (order creation (+on_so)) Pending.objects.create @ apps/transactions/services/proposal_to_order.py:200 (order creation (-on_p)) Pending.objects.create @ apps/transactions/services/flow.py:308 (receive_purchase) Pending.objects.create @ apps/transactions/services/flow.py:452 (complete_workorder)

Invoices — shipment and financial events. Model: apps/transactions/models/invoice.py
Inventory costing layer — tracks on_hand by receipt cost. Model: apps/products/models/inventory_layer.py
